_: The pay phone's directory (src/phone.js). book: what the phone book lists. numbers: digits (7 or 10) to an outcome: kind time | machine | recording | intercept | busy; file is a recording in assets/audio/ when there is one, otherwise the transcript carries it; requires names an item the caller must have found (state.items) or the call gets its locked intercept; ring picks the ringback (us | eu | uk). area: the local area code, so seven digits dial a listed number. exchange: the listed exchange; an unlisted number in it is not in service, one in any other exchange cannot be completed as dialed. intercepts: the phone company's lines, Jane Barbe's when the files arrive (a file that is not there yet falls back to the transcript).
